title: Objectionable Article Appearing In The Ta Ying Yeh Pao On December 22, 1939

page_data.en:
FORM NO. 3
G. 10M-10-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch
REPORT
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. xxx
Date January 7, 1939.

Subject (in full) Objectionable article appearing in the "Ta Ying Yeh Pao"
on December 22.

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Ross.

With reference to the article entitled "Sale of
Maps at a School" published by the "Ta Ying Yeh Pao"(大英夜報)
on December 22, 1938, Mr. Chien Tan-sun (錢坦生 ), Chinese
editor of the paper, was interviewed at headquarters on
December 30 and warned that the publication of articles of
this kind is highly undesirable.

In reply, Mr. Chien explained that the article in
question was contributed by one named Shih Chung-yen (時仲燕),
but he is unable to produce him.

On January 5, the paper published the following
correction :-

A CORRECTION

"The article entitled 'Sale of Maps at a School'
contains something which is untrue. We hereby publish
this correction."

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 6 JAN. 1939）

D. C. (Special Branch)

C. D. I.

Commsr
of
Information

日期 1939年1月7日。

主题（全称） 12月22日《大英夜报》刊登的不当文章。

由 C.D.I. Ross 制作并转发。

关于《大英夜报》于1938年12月22日刊登的题为“学校出售地图”的文章，该报中文编辑钱坦生先生于12月30日在总局接受问询，并被警告称，刊登此类文章极不可取。

作为回应，钱先生解释说，涉案文章是由一名叫时仲燕的人供稿的，但他无法找到此人。

1月5日，该报刊登了如下更正：

更正声明

“题为‘学校出售地图’的文章中含有不实之处。特此刊登此更正。”

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1939年1月6日）

D. C. (特别支部)

C. D. I.

新闻专员
Jno Robertson
DC(SB)

page_data.en:
December 23, 1938. Afternoon Translation.

Ta Ying Yeh Pao on December 22 published the following article
written by Ong Shih Chung-yen (時仲燕) :-

SALE OF MAPS AT A SCHOOL.

The office of the school was crowded with
teachers. Suddenly, a pair of "living devils" entered,
one of whom held a large visiting card, while the other
a leather bag.
These two dwarfs are so fat that when they
walked they seemed to be moving like pigs. They were
dressed in foreign clothing and spoke Chinese. The visiting
card bore the following inscription :- "The Dah Chung
Reformed Society (大中維新會). Shanghai Branch and
Peiping Branch. Telephones: 5558 and 3362."
One of the men opened the leather bag and took
out a map entitled, "The latest detailed map of South and
North China" and in small characters: "Celebration of the
inauguration of the New Chinese Government".
"$5 a map. You must buy ten copies of the
map," said one of the dwarfs.
"Not necessary. We already have many maps here."
"Your maps are out of date. Ours are the
latest maps. Many schools have bought our maps".
A book was then taken out and shown to us.
It revealed that a number of schools have already bought
the map. We all left the office, leaving only a coolie
behind. An hour elapsed, but the devils were still there
waiting for a customer. Pupils became somewhat afraid
upon seeing the devils for their faces had turned very
fierce.
"Better to waste some money to get rid of
these two devils", suggested somebody.
As a result, three maps were bought for $15,
whereupon the devils left.
People living in the Settlement under the
protection of friendly nations cannot avoid being deceived
by small devils. We hope that the Settlement authorities
will be firm in order to preserve their dignity.
page_data.zh:
1938年12月23日。下午译文。

《大英夜报》于12月22日刊登了以下由 Ong Shih Chung-yen (时仲燕) 撰写的文章：

学校出售地图。

学校的办公室里挤满了教师。突然，两个“活鬼”走了进来，其中一个拿着一张很大的名片，另一个拿着一个皮包。
这两个矮子胖得走路时像猪一样挪动。他们穿着洋装，说着中国话。名片上写着：“大中维新会。上海分会和北平分会。电话：5558 和 3362。”
其中一人打开皮包，拿出一张题为“最新中国南北详图”的地图，并在小字处注明：“庆祝新中国政府成立”。
“每张地图5元。你们必须买十张地图，”其中一个矮子说。
“没必要。我们这里已经有很多地图了。”
“你们的地图过时了。 ours 是最新的地图。许多学校都买了我们的地图”。
随后拿出一本书给我们看。书中显示许多学校已经购买了该地图。我们都离开了办公室，只留下一个苦力。一个小时过去了，那些鬼还在等着顾客。学生们看到那些鬼有些害怕，因为他们的脸色变得非常凶恶。
“最好花点钱把这两个鬼打发走”，有人建议道。
结果，花了15元买了三张地图，随后那些鬼就离开了。
生活在友好国家保护下的租界居民，难免被小鬼欺骗。我们希望租界当局能坚定立场，以维护其尊严。

page_data.en:
Standard and other local newspapers :-

COMPLAINTS ABOUT A MAP

Six important bodies, including the
District Association, the National Chamber of Commerce,
the Education Society and the Citizens' Federation, have
sent the following letter of protest to the American
Consul-General in Shanghai, the American Chamber of
Commerce and the R.C.A. Victor Company over the issue of
a ridiculous map by the last named:-
"We have to inform you that in the world
map for radio amusement and education recently issued by
the K.C.A. Victor Company, an American concern, the
following three errors were detected:-
"(1) Manchuria is called a State.
"(2) The abolished five-barred flag is
depicted as the Chinese national flag instead of the flag
of white sun against a Blue Sky.
"(3) It uses different colours for the
various Chinese provinces.
"We have to request that the mistakes be
instantly rectified and that the sale of the map with
the above mentioned errors should cease so as to
maintain our friendly relations."
Upon receipt of the letter of protest,
the R.C.A. Victor Company gave the following reply:-
"Your letter is to hand and we are surprised
to learn of an issue of maps by our company. Ever since
its inauguration in China about forty years ago, our
company has been dealing specially in radio receivers,
gramaphones and gramaphone records. We have never issued
or sold any maps.
"The cause of the present misunderstanding
may be due to the fact that several years ago we received
several sample copies of maps for radio amusement from
a certain advertising company in the U.S.A. They were,
however, considered improper and a telegram to this effect
was sent to the company asking it to cease printing these
maps. All the samples we received were destroyed. We
are totally at a loss to understand how they have re-
appeared. It may be due to the activities of certain
unscrupulous elements who are purposely creating trouble.
We have never issued such maps and hope that the public
will not be misled by them."
Enquiries made by this paper, however,
showed that these maps must have been printed after
November of the 26th Year (1937) of the Chinese Republic,
because the Peiping Provisional Government was inaugurated
on December 14 of the same year when the abolished five-
barred flag was taken into use. Moreover, the puppet
"Mongolian-Sinkiang Federation" was established on
November 23 of that year and it was apparently for
this reason that the territory of Mongolia was printed

page_data.zh:
《标准晚报》及其他本地报纸：

关于一幅地图的投诉

区协会、全国商会、教育会和市民联合会等六个重要团体，就最后提到的美国无线电唱机公司（R.C.A. Victor Company）发行了一幅荒谬的地图一事，向美国驻上海总领事、美国商会以及该公司发出了以下抗议信：
“我们要通知你们，在美国企业 K.C.A. Victor Company 最近发行的用于无线电娱乐和教育的世界地图中，发现了以下三个错误：
“(1) 满洲被称为一个国家。
“(2) 已废除的五色旗被描绘为中国国旗，而不是青天白日旗。
“(3) 中国各省使用了不同的颜色。
“我们要请求立即纠正这些错误，并停止销售带有上述错误的地图，以维持我们的友好关系。”
收到抗议信后，R.C.A. Victor Company 给出了如下回复：
“来信收悉，得知我公司发行地图一事，我们感到惊讶。自约四十年前在中国成立以来，我公司一直专门经营收音机、留声机和留声机唱片。我们从未发行或销售过任何地图。
“造成目前误解的原因可能是几年前我们从美国某广告公司收到了一些用于无线电娱乐的地图样本。然而，我们认为这些样本不当，并为此向该公司发送了电报，要求其停止印刷这些地图。我们收到的所有样本均已被销毁。我们完全不知道它们是如何再次出现的。这可能是某些无良分子故意制造麻烦的活动所致。我们从未发行过此类地图，希望公众不要被其误导。”
然而，本报进行的调查显示，这些地图一定是在中华民国二十六年（1937年）11月之后印刷的，因为北平临时政府于同年12月14日成立，当时已启用已废除的五色旗。此外，傀儡政权“蒙疆联合自治政府”于当年11月23日成立，显然因此原因，蒙古领土在这些地图中被印成

（右上角印章内容：市政警察 / 特别支部登记处 / S. B. D. / 8946 / 日期 _______）
（左下角手写批注：26 / C.9.）

in a different colour in these maps. Therefore, it can
not be true that these maps were printed several years
ago as alleged by the R.C.A. Victor Company, because the
advertising company could not have anticipated by several
years the use of the five-barred flag by the Peiping
Provisional Government. It is learned that local public
bodies are continuing their investigations into the case.

The following notice published by the
R.C.A. Victor Company appears in the "Standard" and other
local newspapers to-day:-
"We were much surprised to read an
article in the 'Standard' yesterday to the effect that
our company had published a map which is being sold at
$0.25 a copy. This company has been in China for more
than 40 years and deals exclusively in radios, gramophones
and gramophone records. We have never issued or sold
any maps. There is absolutely no truth in the allegation
that we have issued or sold maps. Lest the public be
misled by this report, we publish this notice for the
information of the general public."

R.C.A. Victor Company 发布的以下公告今天刊登在《标准晚报》及其他本地报纸上：
“我们非常惊讶地读到昨天《标准晚报》上的一篇文章，称我公司出版了一张以每份0.25美元价格出售的地图。本公司在华已有40多年历史，专门经营收音机、留声机和留声机唱片。我们从未发行或销售过任何地图。关于我们发行或销售地图的说法绝对没有事实依据。为防止公众被此报道误导，特发布此公告以告知广大公众。”

page_data.en:
Ta l:i Pao and other local newspapers: 17 SEP. 1938 A.M.

A RIDICULOUS MAP

A world map for "radio amusement and
education" was recently issued by R.C.A. Victo: Company,
356 Peking Road. In this map China is shown in green;
the Three Eastern Provinces in light yellow and labelled
"Manchukuo", while Mongolia is coloured light red to show
that Manchuria and Mongolia do not belong to China. On
the sides of the map are printed flags of various nations.
The abolished five-barred flag is shown as the Chinese
national flag and placed below the Japanese flag.
This map is publicly on sale at the company
at 25 cents a copy.

（批：2/0? 9/9）
page_data.zh:
《大立报》及其他本地报纸：1938年9月17日 上午

一幅荒谬的地图

位于北京路356号的 R.C.A. Victo: Company 最近发行了一幅用于“无线电娱乐和教育”的世界地图。在这幅地图中，中国显示为绿色；东三省显示为浅黄色，并标注为“满洲国”，而蒙古则涂成浅红色，以表明满洲和蒙古不属于中国。地图两侧印有各国国旗。已废除的五色旗被显示为中国国旗，并置于日本国旗下方。
这幅地图在公司公开出售，每份售价25美分。

（批：2/0? 9/9）
